controls_rule: Freeze all 20 oracle bodies before dynamic observation. Positive original reference must have zero mismatches and adequate samples; fixed output-inversion negative must be detected. Compile/oracle failures remain admission failures, not model failures. Preserve every task, continue inventory for ordinary fixture failures, stop on environment/cleanup/budget failure.
